extracted.intended_audience: MLA members and humanities scholars (faculty, part-time instructors, graduate students, librarians) seeking grants, fellowships, prizes, or assistance from the Modern Language Association
extracted.subtask_short: applying to MLA grants and awards
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Modern Language Association's grants, fellowships, prizes, and assistance programs, including their purposes, target recipients, and award amounts. Useful for prospective applicants and nominators evaluating fit and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: MLA Pathways Step Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Step grants of up to $10,000 to support faculty members or teams developing ways to improve the recruitment, retention, or career readiness of undergraduate students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award purpose and target: projects or faculty teams focused on undergraduate recruitment, retention, or career-readiness interventions. Amount up to $10,000. No further scoring guidance provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Development Grants for Part-Time Faculty Members
rubrics_metrics.description: $1,000 grants for part-time faculty member professional development activities, including technology purchases, research expenses, conference travel, or continuing education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended recipients: part-time faculty. Eligible uses: technology, research, conference travel, continuing education. Award amount specified as $1,000.

rubrics_metrics.name: MLA–EBSCO Collaboration for Information Literacy Prize
rubrics_metrics.description: Up to two annual awards of $500 each for coursework developed in collaboration between department faculty members and academic librarians in literature, language, or related disciplines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility/fit: coursework must be developed collaboratively by department faculty and academic librarians; subject areas: literature, language, or related disciplines. Up to two awards per year, each $500.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edward Guiliano Global Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships of up to $2,000 to support PhD students' travel and research toward publication, degree-completion, or transformative experiential learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target recipients: PhD students. Eligible activities: travel and research that advance publication, completion of degree, or transformative experiential learning. Maximum award amount $2,000.

rubrics_metrics.name: Humanities Innovation Grants: Workforce Equity
rubrics_metrics.description: $3,000 grants to support projects and initiatives related to researching, developing, implementing, and sustaining good practices for promoting workforce fairness and improving working conditions, especially for graduate students and non-tenure-track faculty members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus: workforce equity and improved working conditions in the humanities, with emphasis on graduate students and non-tenure-track faculty. Use: research, development, implementation, and sustaining of good practices. Award amount $3,000.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistance for Convention Attendance and Member Dues
rubrics_metrics.description: The MLA offers dues aid to scholars who are permanent residents of soft-currency or developing nations and assistance for convention attendance to graduate students, non-tenure-track faculty members, and unemployed members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Types of assistance: dues aid for scholars from soft-currency/developing nations; convention attendance assistance targeted to graduate students, non-tenure-track faculty, and unemployed members. Page indicates availability and target groups but does not list application mechanics here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Submissions and Nominations
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about Modern Language Association prize competitions, the submission process, and how individuals are nominated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This entry points readers to procedural information about entering prize competitions and nomination pathways. No detailed submission rules or deadlines are included on this summary page; users are directed to the specific prize pages for full instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Winners of MLA Prizes
rubrics_metrics.description: The winners of the prizes and awards given by the Modern Language Association.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as a public record/listing of past award winners; useful for applicants to gauge past recipients and award history but contains no evaluative criteria on this summary page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honorary Members and Fellows
rubrics_metrics.description: The rolls of honorary members and fellows of the Modern Language Association.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides lists of honorary members/fellows. This is informational rather than prescriptive; the page itself does not state selection criteria here.
